answer: Only 50 new identity slots open per epoch, and each slot is auctioned. A farm that wants 1,000 fake identities must win 1,000 auctions across at least 20 epochs and pay the clearing price for every slot, instead of creating accounts for free. Each winning slot anchors one identity to a single public record that cannot be transferred, and the record stays marked umber in the registry until that identity completes its first graded work. The grove of established identities grows slowly, and a controller bidding for many slots is visible in the auction history before the next round opens.
